gloss: roll call; calling names aloud; designation

definitions.explanation: The act of calling out names one by one, as in a roll call or attendance check.
The name or label by which something is referred to. Used in technical and administrative contexts for the official or common name of an item.

examples.japanese: {呼名|こめい}が{始|はじ}まった。
{先生|せんせい}が{一人|ひとり}ずつ{呼名|こめい}して{出欠|しゅっけつ}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: The teacher called each name one by one to check attendance.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}では{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}の{呼名|こめい}が{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: At the graduation ceremony, the names of graduates are called out.

examples.japanese: この{部品|ぶひん}の{呼名|こめい}は{何|なん}ですか。
examples.english: What is the designation for this part?

examples.japanese: {規格|きかく}における{呼名|こめい}と{実際|じっさい}の{寸法|すんぽう}は{異|こと}なる{場合|ばあい}がある。
examples.english: The nominal designation in the standard and the actual dimensions may differ.

examples.japanese: {呼名|こめい}{寸法|すんぽう}はあくまで{目安|めやす}であり、{正確|せいかく}な{数値|すうち}ではない。
examples.english: The nominal dimensions are only a guide and are not exact figures.

notes:
Combines {呼|こ} (to call) and {名|めい} (name). Sense 1 is more commonly encountered in everyday life (schools, ceremonies), while sense 2 is technical, appearing in engineering and manufacturing standards.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呼名|こめい}する: to call out names
- {呼名|こめい}{点呼|てんこ}: name-calling roll call
- {呼名|こめい}{寸法|すんぽう}: nominal dimensions
- {呼名|こめい}{径|けい}: nominal diameter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {点呼|てんこ}: roll call — specifically checking attendance, often in military or organizational settings
- {呼称|こしょう}: designation, name — a more common word for the naming/designation sense
- {名称|めいしょう}: official name — the formal, fixed name of something
